meta.notes: The call a goat horn plays. sound_event is the vanilla Call call, named by its sound event id. One blow lasts 7 seconds and the horn then cools down as long (use_duration); players hear it 256 blocks away (range). A goat horn plays it when its minecraft:instrument component names msm_starter:storm_call: /give @s minecraft:goat_horn[minecraft:instrument="msm_starter:storm_call"].
